::: {#def-confidence-set}
#### Confidence set

A $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ **confidence set** for a parameter $\param$
is a random subset $C(X)$ of the [parameter space](bayesian-inference.qmd#def-parameter-space),
computed from the data $X$,
such that for every possible value of $\param$:

$$\Prunder{\param}{\param \in C(X)} \ge 1 - \siglevel$$

A [confidence interval](#def-confidence-interval) is a confidence set
whose values are [closed intervals](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/sets.html#def-closed-interval).

Source: [@CaseBerg01, Section 9.1].
:::
